About

A full-cycle engineering and manufacturing company

TPI LUX is an engineering and manufacturing company delivering lighting, infrastructure and specialist technical projects.

We bring design, manufacturing, supply, installation and technical support into one system of work — so that the client receives a single managed process rather than a set of separate services.

We work on private, commercial and municipal projects, helping clients reach a predictable result without having to coordinate contractors themselves.

Our approach is a high standard of product and service without unjustified cost. We take responsibility not only for the supply, but for the result.

Our philosophy

We do not sell separate services. We assemble working solutions for the specific task, bringing experience, technology and delivery into one system.

We do not complicate what can be made clearer. We do not simplify where the result depends on it.

When clients come to us
  • Several contractors need to be brought together into one team.
  • The project has a non-standard task or constraints.
  • Deadlines, quality and accountability matter.
  • What is needed is the result, not process management.

How we work

One route from idea to service

The way we work should be clear to the client before the project starts.

  1. 01Design

    Site analysis, a lighting or engineering concept, calculations and documentation.

  2. 02Manufacturing

    Fabrication of structures and preparation of equipment for the task.

  3. 03Supply

    Procurement for the project, logistics and quality checks before installation.

  4. 04Installation

    Mounting, connection, compliance with safety requirements and deadlines.

  5. 05Commissioning

    Testing, mode setup and scene programming.

  6. 06Service

    Servicing, diagnostics, seasonal work and operational support.
